messages:
nina: saw a canary fail where a quantized safetensors shard decompressed in main thread and starved warmup. Need a short follow-up on decompression & staging semantics.
omar: context: shard is zstd-compressed, streaming path spawns decompress per-chunk, we had 12 concurrent hotplugs -> CPU spike -> evictions -> OOMs.
lucas: what's current contract for streaming vs mmap regarding alignment? we still assume page-aligned writes when we do inplace decode.
maria: exact problem: streaming path tried to mmap then write decompressed bytes into the mapping. because mapping size was rounded up, write offset calculation sometimes hit end of mapping for cross-page chunks.
kevin: we should forbid in-place decompression into mmap unless mapping guarantees >= decompressed_length OR mapper_provides_writeable_contiguous(). otherwise decompress into staging buffer and memcpy.
nina: proposal A: StagingSlab allocator per-model: pre-reserve N bytes (configurable via manifest/staging_hint). decompressed chunks land there, then atomic swap to final backing. prevents double-mmap races.
omar: proposal B: DecompressThreadPool limited to M threads per instance + backpressure token bucket. if pool is saturated, new hotplug requests either queue or fall back to index-first small fetch.
lucas: combine both: if can_reserve(staging_hint) allocate slab and use threadpool; else fall back to streaming-read+ephemeral buffers with strict per-chunk rate-limit.
maria: manifest idea snippet: 
```
"staging_hint_bytes": "268435456",  # optional
"preferred_load_path": "PREFER_STAGING|STREAM_SAFE|INDEX_FIRST"
```
kevin: we also need to discuss atomic swap/visibility: after slab filled, do an atomic pointer swap for loader->weights_view. ensure any concurrent inference either waits on generation fencing or sees older version. avoid partial reads.
nina: implementation notes: 1) loader.acquire_model_lock(model_id) for hotplug; 2) fill slab; 3) verify checksum; 4) atomic publish; 5) release lock. this serializes hotplug per-model but keeps inference unaffected. downside = small serialization latency.
omar: alternative is per-shard fine-grained publish with versioned segment table, but that complicates eviction and index mapping. probably overkill for now.
lucas: telemetry: emit events for reserve_attempt, reserve_result, decompress_queue_delay_ms, publish_latency_ms, fallback_taken.
maria: build-bot: can we add a unit test sim that creates 50 concurrent hotplugs with zstd shards and validates no OOM and that publish is atomic?
build-bot: created job INF-PLUG-1983: concurrent-hotplug-zstd-sim. will add to CI optional suite. ETA end of sprint.
kevin: security note: decompression allocs can be abused by crafted shards; cap decompress_size per-chunk and validate header before allocate.
nina: also for Dedicated, ops can set cluster-wide override: FORCE_RESERVE_STAGING=true which makes loader attempt slab even if manifest omits hint. need to surface cost to customer.
omar: follow-ups: 1) draft small RFC with two patterns (StagingSlab + threadpool with backpressure) and tradeoffs (latency, RAM, complexity) - nina/kevin 2) add loader.can_reserve(size) hook and manifest fields - lucas 3) tests + telemetry - build-bot/maria.
lucas: timeline: RFC + prototype next week; tests in 2 weeks.
maria: thanks everyone. if you see a case we missed (e.g., encrypted shards + staging) call it out here.
kevin: encrypted shards need decrypt-before-decompress so staging must be after decryption; add note in RFC.
nina: will draft and link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/staging-decompress-backpressure (WIP)
